    Import T-100 Data

    Source: R/import_t100.R
    import_t100.Rd

    Imports T-100 Data directly from BTS/RITA/Transtats website raw data (prezipped file), for SKYNET's import function.

    Usage

    import_t100(x, nonsch = FALSE, auto = TRUE)

    Arguments

    x

    T-100 csv

    nonsch

    Should equal TRUE to include non-scheduled flights

    auto

    Automatically assigns object

    Value

    A data frame with one row per route, carrier and month: origin and destination airports and city market ids, carrier, distance, passengers, year, quarter and month (plus seats, departures and aircraft type for segment files). With auto = TRUE it is assigned to the global environment as T100_year_mkt or T100_year_seg (e.g. T100_2011_mkt) and returned invisibly, otherwise it is returned.

    Details

    Files can be found here https://www.transtats.bts.gov/Fields.asp?gnoyr_VQ=FIL. More information on variables to select and type of files to use can be found here

    Examples

    import_t100(skynet_example("T100_2011_mkt.csv"), auto = FALSE)
